alapha888-session-handoff-kit-root.description: Use this skill when context usage approaches capacity (>60%), before running /clear or /compact, when switching tasks, when ending a coding session across Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, or as a mid-session diagnostic — if the agent cannot fill the handoff fields from actual state, the session has drifted. Produces a structured handoff artifact that transfers execution state to a fresh agent session without loss of context or drift.
